authorization_source: Latest explicit user request to reactivate SUNNY with continuous bounded background execution and multiple agents; root operational allocation under that request.
scope: Supporting source-qualified reconstruction jobs and useful exact/record-fidelity checks tied to current scientific dependencies; all16SUNNY goals remain active. No automatic canonical promotion.
old_budget: Preserve state/background/main/model-budget.json unchanged; old255/256 is not reset or silently extended.
renewal: No automatic budget or lease renewal. Stop and expose a blocker when a bound prevents the next complete unit.
progress_rule: Completed relevant result artifacts or a newly raised exact blocker qualify. Heartbeats, repeated completed work, parked generic cases and bare process existence do not establish scientific progress.
constraints: Use existing guarded worker/control patterns and real Jev/Proofline.
No global configuration, trust, security or system-service changes.
No arbitrary shell or code handler added.
Verify process identity before start/reuse/stop and preserve other projects.
No assertion that a bounded classifier independently completes creative research or that an alert file guarantees chat notification.
